scope.inputs: existing frozen synthetic control bundle only

freeze_preflight.method: git diff --quiet 7277efa -- listed paths; no source/label parsing or holdout-answer viewing

historical_capture.note: The partial run and its measured counts remain historical. No final capture was received or rescored during this preparation.

criteria.requirement: Substantive result-dependent model-selected actions and validated finalization/abstention
Retained, created and reorganised structural units with sourced lineage
Function loss/transfer/merge and warranted abstentions on frozen controls
Duplication and potential conflict with legitimate cooperation negative
Exact editions/refs/quotes, source-backed meaning and physical coordinates
Advisory analytical conclusion consistent with published domain outputs
DOCX/PDF/XLSX end-to-end evidence on the integrated revision
Durable reopen, actual UI/export/launch, agent verification route and honest degradation
Separate development metrics, denominators and pending-human/confirmed distinction

after_delivery_record: Fresh revision/run directory with integrity, two existing-scorer outputs, trace argument/result chains, source brief, per-criterion verdict, artifact hashes; then update tracked quality and acceptance index.
acceptance_interpretation: Pass only within evidenced scope; absent mandatory evidence has a concrete blocker and owner. Completed/captured labels, tool counts, AI agreement or historical metrics alone do not pass. No invented accuracy threshold.

independent_preparation_review.scope: Read-only runbook/contract/intake review; no labels, holdout, private helpers or inference
independent_preparation_review.finding: Added explicit created-predecessor-search and unresolved-before-only unit requirements to M1; no remaining actionable findings reported.
